description: Implement Docker Compose setup for local development, GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline, Prometheus + Grafana monitoring configuration, and final project documentation. This ties everything together for local development and deployment.
steps: Create docker-compose.yml with all services: postgres (postgres:16-alpine, port 5432, healthcheck), redis (redis:7-alpine, port 6379, appendonly, maxmemory 256mb, healthcheck), migrate (one-shot prisma migrate deploy), api-gateway (port 3001), wallet-monitor, tx-parser, copy-engine, execution, analytics, notification, prometheus (port 9090), grafana (port 3002). Use x-common-env anchor for shared .env. All services depend on postgres+redis healthy. All app services run as non-root uid 1001.

Create Dockerfile for each service in apps/ (multi-stage: node:22-alpine base, pnpm install, build, prune to production, run as uid 1001). Use a shared Dockerfile.base pattern or per-service Dockerfiles.
Create monitoring/prometheus.yml with scrape configs for all services on /metrics endpoint
Create monitoring/grafana/provisioning/ with datasource (Prometheus) and a basic dashboard JSON for trade latency, throughput, and error rate
Create .github/workflows/ci.yml: on push/PR to main - checkout, setup pnpm, install, lint, build, test, docker compose config validation
Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml: placeholder deployment workflow with build and push stages
Update docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md with complete Docker Compose usage guide, troubleshooting section, and how to run individual services
Ensure README.md 5-command quickstart works: git clone, pnpm install, cp .env.example .env, docker compose up -d, pnpm dev
acceptance_criteria: docker compose config validates without errors
All Dockerfiles have correct syntax and multi-stage build pattern
GitHub Actions workflow YAML is valid
Prometheus config correctly targets all services
README quickstart commands are accurate and complete
All services run as non-root user (uid 1001) in Docker
verification: Run: docker compose config (validates docker-compose.yml syntax)
Run: pnpm build (full project still builds)
Run: pnpm test (all tests still pass)
